question: What happens to residual conceptual thought at death for the trembling knower?
premises: Conceptual thought arises in the body from carelessness.
At the fall of the body, that conceptual thought necessarily perishes.
When it perishes, supreme knowledge is recognized.
inference: Death removes the bodily basis of residual conceptual disturbance, allowing the already-arisen supreme knowledge to stand revealed.
plain_english: Therefore, conceptual thought that arises in the body from carelessness would necessarily perish at the fall of the body, and then supreme knowledge is recognized.
